sources.title: Quasi-Locality Bounds for Quantum Lattice Systems. Part I. Lieb-Robinson Bounds, Quasi-Local Maps, and Spectral Flow Automorphisms
sources.reading_depth: Introduction and Section 2 operator topology definitions; Section 3.1 Lemma 3.2 and its iterative commutator inequality; Sections 3.2–3.3 theorem statements and interaction-picture comparison.
sources.use: Independently checked that consecutive-overlap paths follow from unitary commutator resummation and that unbounded onsite terms require strong-topology distinctions.
sources.limitation: Not a full-paper audit. Locally integrable coefficient extension and four-link constants are separately derived in locality.md. The HTML rendering date is not a new mathematical version date.

sources.title: On the dynamics of lattice systems with unbounded on-site terms in the Hamiltonian
sources.reading_depth: Lemma 2.2, commutator iteration around equations 71–73, Theorem 4.1, and finite-volume Duhamel comparison around equations 83–88.
sources.use: Confirmed that local volume convergence survives unbounded onsite terms through the interaction picture, while norm continuity cannot be assumed for arbitrary bounded operators.
sources.limitation: The workbench result is a scoped application; this review does not independently reconstruct every proof in the paper.

sources.title: Quasi-particles in weak perturbations of non-interacting quantum lattice systems
sources.reading_depth: Definitions and Theorems 1–3 on PDF pages 2–4; selected expansion, norm estimate and ground-state convergence discussion on pages 6–9.
sources.use: Checked infinite-dimensional onsite spaces, unbounded selfadjoint onsite operators, unique unit gap, finite-range bounded perturbations, volume-independent existential constants, and the canonical GNS generator.
sources.limitation: The full cluster expansion was not independently reproduced. Blocking, boundary padding and Gauss restriction are separately reviewed applications. No numerical threshold was extracted.

plot_reviews.finding: Axes, legend, title and three recorded log-width curves are readable. Raw rational intervals and CSV logarithms are independently checked by audit_moments.py.
Mean, susceptibility, exact origin value and both wrong-model controls have readable axes and legends. Numerical inputs are audited separately.
